'''Jiaozuo Wuzhi-1 Cogen power station''' (焦作韩电公司武陟热电厂) is an operating power station of at least 100-megawatts (MW) in Wuzhi, Jiaozuo, Henan, China.

==Background==

Jiaozuo Cogen power station is a two-unit coal-fired power plant with a total capacity of 100 MW. The plant was completed in 2006, and is owned by [[KEPCO]].<ref>[http://enipedia.tudelft.nl/wiki/Jiaozuo_Cogen_Powerplant Jiaozuo Cogen Powerplant], Enipedia, accessed Sept. 2015.</ref><ref>[http://finance.qq.com/a/20081030/003595.htm "焦作9千万韩资热电站巨亏 欲1美元卖给许继,"] finance.qq.com, 2008年10月30日</ref>
